data.title: bn-3odg: foldhash for the active-index streams map -- DECLINE with table
data.description: Premise check under the pre-registered rule (adopt only if the composed engine can see the win). Verdict: DECLINE. Micro map-level win is real (+21..35% insert, +5..13% read, 40..250k streams, null control +/-4.5%, 2 independent runs); composed A/B on mess-bench --only live_tail and --only reader_contention (8 ABBA blocks each, trunk-vs-trunk-rebuild null control interleaved) put all 13 metrics inside the +/-5..8% null band. Arithmetic ceiling: the hasher is worth <=0.12% of any composed metric. Product diff is comment-only: a note on Shard::streams recording that the obvious conversion was built, tested green, measured and declined. The conversion itself was reverted -- no behaviour change. Precondition check: the streams map is never iterated order-sensitively (sole iteration, ActiveIndex::snapshot, collects into a BTreeMap), so the swap stays admissible if a future workload ever earns it.
